row.team_price_text: Core: from $83/mo (10K sessions/mo, session-based, billed monthly)
row.evidence: LogRocket's SSO doc says SAML/AD SSO (Azure AD, Okta) is set up by reaching out to LogRocket, and users are managed manually in Settings > Team Members; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the pricing page or the docs index.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). Pricing reworked since June: plans are now Core, Pro (+ Galileo AI) and Enterprise, priced by sessions captured; the pricing script lists Core at $83/mo for 10K sessions and $176/mo at the 25K default (June's 'from $69/mo' no longer appears), Pro from 250K sessions, Enterprise Contact Sales. Prices are monthly by default; annual is discounted via sales. Pricing page lists 'SSO' under Core, but the SSO doc describes Google sign-in domain auto-join and says SAML (Azure AD, Okta) is set up on request, so the SAML plan is not stated. June note that Enterprise includes SAML is not supported by a first-party page and is dropped. No SCIM or user-management API is documented; the public REST API covers audit-log export (Pro/Professional).

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Pricing page lists 'SSO' in Core; docs describe Google-domain SSO, SAML on request.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: from $1,004/mo at 250K sessions/mo (Galileo AI included free above 100K sessions)

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented anywhere searched; recorded as none by absence.

limitations.text: Team members are added and removed only by Admins in Settings > Team Members; no API for this is documented.

user_api.notes: No user-management REST API documented. The documented REST API (api.logrocket.com/v1) covers audit-log export; other APIs are the Galileo Highlights, User Identification (end-user data) and MCP server.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/logrocket/ and logrocket-saml return 404; LogRocket says Okta SAML is set up by request.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google sign-in domain auto-join: users with a verified email on the configured domain join the organization on first Google sign-in (social sign-in, not customer-IdP SAML).
